title: Bank ledger
prompt:
A bank keeps accounts named by a single capital letter; every account has an integer balance. Process the commands listed at the end in order and print exactly one line per command, following these rules.
- `open X n` creates account X with balance n. If X already exists, print `X exists` and change nothing; otherwise print `opened X`.
- `deposit X n` adds n to X. If X does not exist print `X unknown`; otherwise print `X balance B`, where B is the new balance.
- `withdraw X n` subtracts n from X. If X does not exist print `X unknown`; if the balance would become negative print `X insufficient` and change nothing; otherwise print `X balance B` with the new balance.
- `transfer X Y n` takes n from X and gives n to Y, and X also pays a fee of 1. If X or Y does not exist print `unknown account`; if the balance of X is less than n + 1 print `X insufficient` and change nothing; otherwise apply the transfer and print `X balance B1 Y balance B2` with the new balances. If X and Y are the same account, nothing is moved but the fee of 1 is still paid, and both printed balances are the balance after the fee.
- `close X` removes X. If X does not exist print `X unknown`; if its balance is not 0 print `X not empty`; otherwise print `closed X`.
Commands, in order: open A 100; open B 50; open A 10; deposit C 5; withdraw B 70; transfer A B 60; transfer B A 112; transfer B A 109; transfer A A 5; withdraw A 25; close B; transfer A B 1; deposit A 7; withdraw A 15; close A; open B 0; close B.
